note: 0.1.16 review follow-up: `git push --all`, `--branches` and `--mirror` reach every branch, protected ones too, so classes() reads them as the protected-push gate whatever the target names (risk already did); with the gate tier they are never gate-allowed by words (no branch to name). Neighbours pinned as they were: a delete of main (`:main`, `--delete main`) and a `+` force refspec to main (`+main`, `+HEAD:main`, also force-push) are protected-push; a tag push stays protected-push by the unnamed-push rule; a push of feat/x carries. A push that deletes a branch (--delete, -d, a :<branch> refspec) is gate-allowed only when the granting words say delete or remove.
